rulesDescriptions.mrp: MRP must be declared in Indian Rupees (₹) with the mandatory statutory phrase 'inclusive of all taxes'. Dual pricing or charging higher prices violates Section 36.
rulesDescriptions.net_qty: Weight or measure must be declared strictly in standard SI units (g, kg, ml, l). Use of non-standard symbols like 'gm' or 'ltr' is illegal.
rulesDescriptions.mfg_date: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured, packed, or imported must be clearly indicated.
rulesDescriptions.manufacturer: The complete registered address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer must be declared on the principal display panel.
rulesDescriptions.consumer_care: Contact details (Telephone, Email) of the grievance redressal cell must be clearly printed for consumer redressal.
rulesDescriptions.usp: Unit Sale Price (₹/g, ₹/ml, ₹/kg, ₹/l) must be printed on retail packages. Exempt if net quantity equals 1 kg/1 L/1 unit.
rulesDescriptions.font_compliance: Numeral and letter sizes must strictly comply with Table II minimum heights based on the surface area of the Principal Display Panel.
rulesDescriptions.category_statutory: Category-specific mandates like FSSAI (Foods/Drinks), M-Lic (Cosmetics), or Country of Origin (Electronics).
